name: Coursera
summary: Coursera committed to a workforce reduction on 6 July 2026, two months after completing its merger with Udemy, and filed a California WARN notice for 31 people in San Jose on 14 July.

facts.label: What the company filed
facts.figure: a workforce reduction plan, committed to on 6 July 2026
facts.detail: Disclosed in the company's own filing with the SEC, in connection with its merger with Udemy, which completed on 11 May 2026.

facts.label: Set aside for severance and benefits
facts.detail: The company's estimate, which it says consists primarily of severance payments and health benefits for affected employees.

facts.label: California WARN filing
facts.figure: 31 people at the San Jose site, notice dated 14 July 2026
facts.detail: WARN counts one site in one state. Coverage elsewhere is not on public record, so the company-wide number is not shown here.
facts.source_name: California WARN filings via WARN Firehose
